validation_criteria: The benchmark should sustain elevated MySQL CPU while remaining read-only.
EXPLAIN for the calibration query should show a multi-table join with row estimates consistent with the configured selectivity and fanout.
The mechanism should be sensitive to missing supporting indexes on the fact-table join path.
If secondary query-cache effects are absent, the join/fanout mechanism should still reproduce the core CPU symptom.
symptom_evidence: High user-space CPU on the database host during the workload.
Low throughput or rising latency as concurrency increases.
No comparable CPU saturation on the application/web tier.
mechanism_evidence: Join fanout is visible in the plan and data shape.
Selective predicates are present but not enough to eliminate the large fact-table join work.
Rows examined remain high relative to the returned result set.
